content.title: Eid 2026 Date Confirmed: Saudi Arabia to Celebrate on March 20 | India Eid Date
content.text: Eid al-Fitr 2026 will be celebrated in Saudi Arabia on March 20 after the Shawwal crescent moon was not sighted on March 18, completing 30 days of Ramadan. The UAE and other Gulf countries will follow the same date, while South Asian nations like India and Pakistan are likely to celebrate on March 21. The UAE has announced Eid prayers will be held only in mosques.
